**Proofpress** — the version ledger for agent-produced knowledge work.
Every draft your agent ships is a proof. You mark it up, sign off, and send it to press.
Draft → Review → Approve, for agents.

Others run agents and store work. We keep the books on what agents produce: what changed (semantic diff), why it changed (session provenance), and whether your feedback was addressed (comment → resolution). Any agent can write to it. Humans decide. Your infrastructure.
Once agents take over the production side of knowledge work, the scarce resource is no longer output — it's trust. Trust needs a ledger:

- **Artifacts + version chain** — a deliverable has stable identity; every version is an immutable object you can judge, roll back, and compare.
- **Block tree** — the canonical representation is a tree of blocks with stable IDs; formats (markdown today) are projections agents edit. Comments anchor to blocks and survive across versions.
- **Semantic diff** — structure (moved / rewritten / new), word-level, table cells, numeric deltas, and the agent's own changelog (verified against the computed diff). For the same change, git shows you 40 red and 42 green lines; this shows you one readable summary.
- **Provenance** — every changed block links back to the session turns that produced it. "Why did this change?" stays answerable three weeks later.
The ledger is an open spec, neutral to any agent harness. It versions the knowledge artifacts *around* your code — ADRs, design docs, PRDs — and **never versions code files; that's git's territory.**

Proofpress is the markdown vertical on that ledger, distributed as skills: `pip install proofpress` starts a local ledger plus a localhost review page; install a skill into Claude Code / Codex / any harness and your agent's output suddenly has history. No migration — just install something, and versions appear. The ledger itself lives inside your git repo on a dedicated ref (`refs/proofpress/ledger`) — GitHub carries it for free, your branches never see it.
Pre-M0. Design docs live in [docs/](docs/) (currently written in Chinese — working notes of the founding discussions; English versions will accompany the public launch):

- [STRATEGY.md](docs/STRATEGY.md) — positioning, the four-bucket competitive frame, GTM
- [ARTIFACT_MODEL.md](docs/ARTIFACT_MODEL.md) — data model, diff layers, open questions
- [DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) — design system for the review page
- [EVOLUTION-2026-07-18.md](docs/EVOLUTION-2026-07-18.md) — the full evolution of the founding strategy discussion (a live sample of this product's own value proposition)
- [COMPETITIVE.md](docs/COMPETITIVE.md) — competitive scan (verified 2026-07-18)
- [demo/launch.html](demo/launch.html) — launch-film demo (open in a browser)
- [docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md](docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md) — 60-second narration script
The team layer (multi-reviewer, approval policies, hosting) is a later act on the same ledger. Engine: the omnigent session layer — multi-harness, invisible.
